The '''Las Lagon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Las Lagon]], which seceded from the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] to join the [[Confederation]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].
